none: PAS NLM-98CEB5: Roman Coin: Nummus of Helena
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Helena (324-341), Pax Publica issue of 337-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust coiffed right. Obverse inscription: [--]HE[--]. Reverse description: Pax standing left with transverse sceptre and branch. Reverse inscription: [PAX PVBLICA]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.3mm, Weight: 0.75gms, die axis: probably 12
